note: AddonForge catalogue for WoW: Forever (interface 16001). This is a pointer list, not a host: each entry says where the author publishes releases and AddonForge downloads straight from there. Add an addon by pull request. Fields: id, name, desc, category, github (owner/repo with GitHub Releases), wago (Wago Addons id, needs the user's own key), wowi (WoWInterface id), tukui (slug), curse (CurseForge id, link-out only), asset_hint (substring that picks the right zip when a release has several and no release.json), folders (top-level AddOns folders the zip installs), url, forever (true = author ships a Forever build; false = not yet). Entries with no github/wago/wowi/tukui are link-only so people know where the addon lives. Optional per-entry fields: notice (short amber line on the installed row), added (YYYY-MM-DD, when the entry was listed). Top-level: bundles (starter packs). curse_locked: true marks an author who has switched off third-party downloads on CurseForge (the curse id is then a link only).
